title: universalHomeomorphism_identity
statement: For a universal homeomorphism u : X' → X, the identity morphism on X has the canonical etale-set, lower-star, upper-star, and additive lower-star identity isomorphisms, and for every additive sheaf F, degree q, and x in H^q(F), the map induced by the upper-star identity sends cohomologyMap (𝟙 X) F q x to x.

proof.text: Use the continuous-functor sheaf pullback adjunction at the identity morphism and lowerStarId. Mathlib Adjunction.leftAdjointIdIso compares the left adjoint with the identity functor directly.

Use lowerStarId with Type coefficients for the second isomorphism, upperStarId with additive coefficients for the third, and lowerStarId with additive coefficients for the fourth. The identity clause of cohomologyPullbackFunctorial gives exactly the displayed equality for every F, q and x.

lean.statement: theorem universalHomeomorphism_identity {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (u : X' ⟶ X) [IsUniversalHomeomorphism u] : Nonempty (Scheme.etaleSetPullback (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _) ∧ Nonempty (lowerStar (Type (u + 1)) (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _) ∧ Nonempty (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _) ∧ Nonempty (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (𝟙 X) ≅ 𝟭 _) ∧ ∀ (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (x : Sheaf.H F q), Sheaf.H.map ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X).hom.app F) q (cohomologyMap (𝟙 X) F q x) = x
